'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Bill Kafer LS Mind What You Have Learned (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned (V) / Save You It Can (V)|VB6-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' meatFlaps
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
